description: This file contains unit tests for the IdClashAttributeAnalyzer, which detects duplicate [Id] attributes in Orleans serialization types. The tests verify that the analyzer correctly identifies conflicts in classes, structs, records, and record structs marked with [GenerateSerializer], and ignores types without this attribute.

classes.name: IdClashAttributeAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for IdClashAttributeAnalyzer, containing multiple test cases to check detection of duplicate [Id] attributes in various serialized types.

methods.name: VerifyHasDiagnostic
methods.description: Asserts that the provided code samples produce the expected number of diagnostics (errors) from the analyzer.

methods.name: VerifyHasNoDiagnostic
methods.description: Asserts that the provided code samples do not produce any diagnostics from the analyzer.

methods.name: TypesWithGenerateSerializerAndDuplicatedIds_ShouldTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test case verifying that classes, structs, records, and record structs with duplicate [Id] attributes inside [GenerateSerializer] produce diagnostics.

methods.name: TypesWithGenerateSerializerAndNoDuplicatedIds_ShouldNoTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test case verifying that serialized types with unique [Id] attributes do not produce diagnostics.

methods.name: TypesWithoutGenerateSerializerAndDuplicatedIds_ShouldNotTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test case verifying that types lacking the [GenerateSerializer] attribute, even with duplicate [Id], do not produce diagnostics, ensuring the analyzer only applies to serialized types.
